BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-pathwalker
BundleInfo.Author: Matthew Baker and PathWalker contributors
BundleInfo.Synopsis: PathWalker: pseudoatom seeding and backbone tracing in density maps
BundleInfo.Description: Ports the PathWalker workflow to ChimeraX, including pseudoatom seeding from maps, LKH-based backbone tracing, editable trace manipulation, fixed edges, and helix replacement.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: PathWalker :: CryoModel :: Model building with TSP tracing
